headlines.title: Watch President Trump's full tribute to Sen. Lindsey Graham
headlines.description: Watch President Trump's full tribute to Sen. Lindsey Graham during the funeral service at Washington National Cathedral. The president recalled their past working together and previous rivalry running against each other in 2016.

headlines.title: Netanyahu joins Trump for high-stakes meeting at the White House
headlines.description: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu met with President Donald Trump and attended Sen. Lindsey Graham’s funeral.

headlines.title: Tornado Flattens Wisconsin Neighborhoods as Storm Moves East
headlines.description: A destructive tornado tore through Wisconsin on Monday, leaving entire neighborhoods flattened. The twister is part of a powerful severe storm system that slammed multiple states and that is now moving east. NBC’s Maggie Vespa reports and Weekend TODAY meteorologist Angie Lassman tracks the forecast.

headlines.title: Apalachee High School shooter Colt Gray sentenced to life without parole
headlines.description: WINDER, Ga. — The teenager who idolized mass murderers and used the assault-style rifle he got for Christmas to kill two students and two teachers at his Georgia high school will spend the rest of his life in prison.

headlines.title: Kentucky Gov. Beshear demands 'transparency and honesty' on McConnell's health
headlines.description: Kentucky Gov. Andy Beshear told reporters that constituents are asking for “transparency and honesty” regarding the health of Sen. Mitch McConnell. “We have seen rampant speculation across social media and elsewhere, it could all be fully avoided, and it's all within Senator McConnell's power,” Beshear said. “But because he won't do that, the fact is that we don't know, and that means that the Senate, if he won't provide more evidence, needs to step in and demand it.”

headlines.title: A major earthquake strikes southern Japan
headlines.description: The Japan Meteorological Agency said the earthquake, with a preliminary magnitude of 7.1 and a depth of just over 6 miles, was at the highest end of the seismic intensity scale. NBC News' Raf Sanchez reports on the initial damage caused by the earthquake.

headlines.title: Witness video of Madison police killing raises questions of why lethal force was used
headlines.description: Local authorities said that the matter is being investigated and that the officers involved have been placed on administrative leave.

headlines.title: Ghost gun recovered in deadly Seattle festival shooting
headlines.description: A loaded ghost gun was recovered at the scene of a deadly Seattle shooting over the weekend, police said Tuesday as they continue to search for a possible third suspect.

headlines.title: How Ken Martin is holding on as DNC chair — for now: From the Politics Desk
headlines.description: In today’s edition, Natasha Korecki digs into Ken Martin’s woes at the Democratic National Committee.

headlines.title: Trump hasn’t asked the Supreme Court to rehear birthright citizenship case despite his vow
headlines.description: The White House‘s deadline to ask the Supreme Court to reconsider the ruling that struck down Trump’s effort to limit birthright citizenship was Monday night.

headlines.title: Kentucky governor tells Mitch McConnell: Prove you can serve or ‘resign’
headlines.description: Gov. Andy Beshear issued his ultimatum in letters to McConnell and Senate Majority Leader John Thune, warning that he may begin the process of replacing him.
